caption: The drawing depicts a sundial set on a square, slightly tilted base with rounded, beveled edges and a small circle in each corner, which could represent screw holes. The sundial consists of a horizontal flat plate, colored in shades of tan, grey, and brown, with an engraved circular face in the center. Around the edge of the circular face are Roman numerals indicating the hours. In the middle of the sundial, a triangular gnomon, colored in a darker brown, rises at an angle from the base and is supported by a curved brace attached to its vertical side. The gnomon casts a shadow across the plate. The overall background is off-white with a faint light beige rectangle behind the sundial, possibly to highlight the object. The illustration is realistic and detailed, showing clear attention to the engraved markings and structural elements of the sundial.
title: Sun Dial
